0.$description: Pure white. Contrast: use for text/on-strong and surfaces that need maximum lift (≥4.5:1 with neutral-950).

50.$description: Warm off-white canvas. Contrast: default light canvas; pair with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

100.$description: Light neutral wash. Contrast: soft fills; keep body text off this at small sizes (≥4.5:1).

200.$description: Subtle border / wash. Contrast: non-text UI ≥3:1 against canvas.

300.$description: Muted neutral. Contrast: large text or icons ≥3:1.

400.$description: Disabled / tertiary candidate. Contrast: do not use for small body text on canvas (<4.5:1 risk).

500.$description: Mid neutral. Contrast: borders and secondary chrome ≥3:1.

700.$description: Strong secondary / status text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft fills.

800.$description: Dark surface candidate. Contrast: pair with light text (≥4.5:1).

900.$description: Dark elevated surface. Contrast: pair with light text (≥4.5:1).

950.$description: Near-black ink. Contrast: primary text on light surfaces (≥4.5:1); strong fills with text/on-strong.

100.$description: Danger soft fill (light). Contrast: pair with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

300.$description: Danger mid. Contrast: large text/icons only unless verified.

400.$description: Danger bright. Contrast: verify ≥4.5:1 before text use.

500.$description: Danger strong (dark mode). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

700.$description: Danger text (light) / strong-hover. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft danger.

900.$description: Danger soft fill (dark). Contrast: pair with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

100.$description: Warning soft fill (light). Contrast: pair with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

300.$description: Warning strong (both modes — deliberate). Contrast: MUST use text/on-strong-warning (neutral-950), not white.

400.$description: Warning mid. Contrast: verify before text use.

600.$description: Warning deep. Contrast: with light text if used as fill.

700.$description: Warning text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft warning.

800.$description: Warning deep dark. Contrast: with light text.

900.$description: Warning soft fill (dark). Contrast: pair with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

100.$description: Success soft fill (light). Contrast: pair with text/success (≥4.5:1).

300.$description: Success mid. Contrast: large text/icons unless verified.

400.$description: Success bright. Contrast: verify ≥4.5:1 before text use.

700.$description: Success text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft success.

800.$description: Success deep. Contrast: with light text.

900.$description: Success soft fill (dark). Contrast: pair with text/success (≥4.5:1).

100.$description: Info soft fill (light). Contrast: pair with text/info (≥4.5:1).

300.$description: Info / link (dark). Contrast: links ≥4.5:1 on dark canvas.

400.$description: Info bright. Contrast: verify before small text.

600.$description: Info strong (light) / link. Contrast: links ≥4.5:1 on light canvas.

800.$description: Info deep. Contrast: with light text.

900.$description: Info soft fill (dark). Contrast: pair with text/info (≥4.5:1).

100.$description: AI soft fill (light). Contrast: pair with text/ai (≥4.5:1).

300.$description: AI mid. Contrast: large text/icons unless verified.

400.$description: AI bright. Contrast: verify ≥4.5:1 before text use.

700.$description: AI text (light) / strong-hover. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft AI.

900.$description: AI soft fill (dark). Contrast: pair with text/ai (≥4.5:1).

tint.$description: Selected field hover (light). Contrast: with selected/text (neutral-950) ≥4.5:1.

accent.$description: Selected / wayfinding fill. Contrast: with selected/text (neutral-950) ≥4.5:1. Not for primary buttons.

accent-hover.$description: Selected hover fill. Contrast: with selected/text (neutral-950) ≥4.5:1.

deep.$description: Selected indicator (light). Contrast: ≥3:1 as non-text chrome.

field-shade.$description: Selected field hover (dark). Contrast: with selected/text ≥4.5:1.
